blocks.html: Machine learning researcher building deep learning methods for medical imaging and other data-scarce settings. Experience across vision, language technologies and scientific modeling, with strong Python and PyTorch skills.

roles.title: ML Research Assistant
bullets: Achieved 76% AUC in two-year sarcoma metastasis prediction under data-scarce conditions (51 samples) using a Multi-Instance Contrastive Learning pipeline.
Achieved a 99% AUC for locating tumors in sarcoma patients’ MRI scans by fine-tuning a RadImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50.
Implemented an MRI preprocessing workflow featuring N4 bias field correction, fat/muscle-based intensity normalization, and spatial resampling.

roles.title: Research Assistant
bullets: Performed two elastin-like polypeptide (ELPs) characterization through X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, contact angle, and Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), and ELP ellipsometry
Investigated the temperature transition effect of two ELPs on their hydration and rehydration using quartz crystal microbalance with dissipation (QCM-D)
Analyzed uremic toxin-protein layer adsorption behavior over time using QCM-D

roles.title: Research Intern
bullets: Designed deterministic models to simulate industrial processes and component interactions
Optimized system constraints and continuous variables, ensuring strict alignment with real-world target metrics and operational data

blocks.role: Breast cancer classification from gene expression data

blocks.role: Targeting Prototheca with Tubulin Binding Agents
items: Developed an alternative therapeutic strategy for mastitis in dairy cows by identifying antimicrotubular agents targeting Prototheca Zopfii tubulin, using homology modeling, molecular docking, and dynamics simulations.
